**Thanks for the pull request!** Before anything else: this repository is a mirror of the
[`client/` folder in Rubylight](https://github.com/RamazanKara/Rubylight/tree/main/client), where
Nightjar is developed. Pull requests opened here are not merged.

Please open your change against
**[RamazanKara/Rubylight](https://github.com/RamazanKara/Rubylight/compare)** instead. Once it is
merged there it reaches Nightjar automatically. Link this pull request in the new one so the
discussion stays together, then close this one.

[Rubylight's contributing guide](https://github.com/RamazanKara/Rubylight/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)
has the build steps and the rules for a pull request.

## What this changes

What a user would notice, and why. Link the issue it fixes.

## Testing

The device, OS or platform you built it on, and what you ran or measured.

## Checklist

- [ ] Opened against [Rubylight](https://github.com/RamazanKara/Rubylight/compare), not this mirror
- [ ] One change, with the issue it fixes linked
- [ ] Screenshots for UI changes
- [ ] GPL-3.0-only, like the rest of the project
